D072 specifically links the $1.8B cost of sales to lower Altera and Mobileye revenue. D073 notes flat operating expenses. The 2025 disclosures (D039, D040) provide a comparative view of the 'All other' segment's operating performance. D039 explains the 2025 operating income ($264M) vs 2024 loss ($57M), attributing the change to Mobileye and Altera performance. D040 details the 2024 loss ($57M) vs 2023 income, also citing Altera and Mobileye. The core subject is the financial result and drivers of the 'All other' segment, specifically the transition from the 2024 loss (defined by costs/expenses in D072/D073) to the 2025 profit. D072 and D073 are thematically linked as the components of the 2024 'All other' P&L, just as D039 and D040 are linked as the comparative performance analysis involving the same segment and drivers. While D072/D073 are Cost/Expense and D039/D040 are Income/Loss, they describe the same underlying business unit performance topic across years.
